import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Create a synthetic dataset mimicking financial transactions
n_transactions = 1000

# Transaction features
transaction_ids = np.arange(1, n_transactions + 1)
amounts = np.random.exponential(scale=100, size=n_transactions)
transaction_types = np.random.choice(['purchase', 'transfer', 'withdrawal'], size=n_transactions)
locations = np.random.choice(['New York', 'San Francisco', 'Los Angeles', 'Chicago'], size=n_transactions)

# Injecting anomalies (fraudulent transactions)
anomaly_indices = np.random.choice(n_transactions, size=50, replace=False)
amounts[anomaly_indices] *= np.random.uniform(5, 10, size=50)  # Inflate amounts for anomalies

# Create the DataFrame
transactions_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'TransactionID': transaction_ids,
    'Amount': amounts,
    'TransactionType': transaction_types,
    'Location': locations
})

# Rename columns to obfuscate semantics
transactions_df.rename(columns={
    'TransactionID': 'TransID',
    'Amount': 'TransAmount',
    'TransactionType': 'TransType',
    'Location': 'TransLocation'
}, inplace=True)

# Inject a canary value
transactions_df.loc[0, 'TransAmount'] = -9999  # Canary value to detect contamination

# Introduce missing values
missing_indices = np.random.choice(n_transactions, size=20, replace=False)
transactions_df.loc[missing_indices, 'TransType'] = np.nan

# Save the mutated dataset
transactions_df.to_csv('dataset.csv', index=False)
